title: Your account and security
body:
# Your account and security

## Passwords

We never ask for your password or your full card number, by email, chat or phone.

To reset your password, use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

After 5 failed sign-in attempts, your account is locked for 15 minutes.

## Two-step verification

You can turn on two-step verification in your account settings. It is optional.

## Changing your email address

We send a confirmation link to your old email address. The change happens only after you confirm it.

## Saved cards

Saved cards are stored by our payment processor. Your account shows only the last 4 digits.

## Deleting your account

Ask for deletion with the form in your account settings. We delete the account within 30 days.

## Guest checkout

You can order without an account. Guest orders cannot earn Rewards points.

title: Courier claims for damaged or lost parcels
body:
# Courier claims for damaged or lost parcels

## Purpose
We file claims with the courier when a parcel is damaged or lost. The customer never deals with the courier.

## File the claim
- File the claim in the courier's portal within 7 days after the customer reports the problem.
- Attach the customer's photos and the tracking number.
- Name the claim CLM- followed by the courier code and the order number, for example CLM-PUR-LK-702219.

## Courier codes
- CPX: Canada Post Expedited, for parcels.
- PUR: Purolator, for express parcels.
- LTL: the freight carrier for large items.

## While the claim is open
Do not wait for the courier's answer before sending the customer a replacement or a refund.

title: Damaged, faulty on arrival or wrong items
body:
# Damaged, faulty on arrival or wrong items

## Report within 14 days

Report an item that arrived damaged, faulty or wrong within 14 days of delivery. Send a photo of the item and of the label on the box.

## Replacement or refund

We send a replacement at no cost, or a full refund if no replacement is in stock.

## Do I need to send it back?

- Items under 50 dollars: no, you can keep or recycle the damaged item.
- Items of 50 dollars or more: we send a free return label, or arrange a free pickup for items over 30 kg.

## Wrong item

We send a free return label. We ship the right item as soon as the courier scans the return parcel.

## Missing parts

Tell us the part number from the manual. We send missing parts free of charge within 5 business days.

## After 14 days

A fault found more than 14 days after delivery is handled under the warranty policy.

title: Delivery policy
body:
# Delivery policy

## Where we deliver

We deliver to every province and territory in Canada. We do not deliver outside Canada.

Items over 30 kg are not delivered to post office boxes. Large items follow the large item delivery policy and are not delivered to the territories.

## Delivery times and fees

Delivery times are counted in business days (Monday to Friday, except statutory holidays) from the day your order ships. The free-shipping threshold is the order value before tax.

| Destination | Standard delivery | Standard fee | Express delivery (1 to 2 business days, 14.95 dollars) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ontario and Quebec | 3 to 5 business days | 9.95 dollars, free at 100 dollars or more | Toronto, Ottawa and Montreal |
| British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan and Manitoba | 3 to 5 business days | 9.95 dollars, free at 100 dollars or more | Vancouver, Calgary and Edmonton |
| New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland and Labrador | 3 to 5 business days | 9.95 dollars, free at 100 dollars or more | Not available |
| Yukon, Northwest Territories and Nunavut | 7 to 12 business days | 9.95 dollars, free at 100 dollars or more, plus a 15.00-dollar northern surcharge on every order | Not available |

Express delivery is not available for large items.

## Late and lost orders

If your order arrives more than 5 business days late, we refund the shipping fee.

An order more than 15 business days late is treated as lost. We send a replacement or a full refund, as you prefer.

## Changing the address or the delivery date

You can change the address or delivery date while your order status is Processing.

Once your order has shipped, we cannot change the address or redirect the parcel.

## Orders in several boxes

Some orders ship in several boxes that can arrive on different days.

If a box is missing, wait 2 business days after the first box arrives, then contact us.

## Signature on delivery

Orders over 500 dollars need a signature on delivery.

## Damaged parcels

If an item arrives damaged, follow the policy for damaged, faulty or wrong items: send a photo within 14 days of delivery.

## Combien de temps prend la livraison au Québec?

La livraison standard prend de 3 à 5 jours ouvrables. Les frais sont de 9,95 $, ou gratuits pour une commande de 100 $ ou plus avant taxes.

La livraison express est offerte à Montréal : 1 à 2 jours ouvrables, au coût de 14,95 $.

La TPS et la TVQ s’appliquent selon votre adresse de livraison au Québec.

## Comment retourner un article?

Vous pouvez retourner les articles non utilisés dans les 30 jours suivant la livraison.

Demandez une étiquette de retour dans votre compte, sous Commandes.

## Quand vais-je recevoir mon remboursement?

Une fois le remboursement approuvé, l’argent apparaît en général dans un délai de 5 à 10 jours ouvrables, selon votre banque.

Oui, nous vous répondons en français du lundi au vendredi, de 9 h à 17 h (heure de l'Est), par clavardage, formulaire Web ou téléphone au 1-800-555-0142.

title: Garantie légale au Québec
body:
# Garantie légale au Québec

## Deux garanties différentes

Au Québec, la Loi sur la protection du consommateur prévoit une garantie légale : un produit doit pouvoir servir à un usage normal pendant une durée raisonnable.

La garantie légale s’ajoute à la garantie commerciale de Larkfield (voir la politique de garantie Larkfield). Elle ne la remplace pas.

## Après la fin de la garantie Larkfield

Si vous êtes au Québec et que votre produit tombe en panne après la fin de la garantie Larkfield, vous pouvez quand même faire une demande au titre de la garantie légale.

Nous étudions chaque demande au cas par cas, selon le prix du produit, son usage et sa durée de vie normale.

## Garantie prolongée

Nous ne vendons pas de garantie prolongée.

## Comment faire une demande

Contactez notre service à la clientèle avec votre numéro de commande et une photo ou une courte vidéo du problème.

Le service en français est offert du lundi au vendredi, de 9 h à 17 h (heure de l'Est).

title: How Larkfield policies are managed
body:
# How Larkfield policies are managed

## Purpose

This collection is the single source of Larkfield's customer policies, staff procedures, product guides, help articles and notices.

Our help-desk agents and the policy assistant answer only from these documents.

## Document types

- **Policy:** The rules for customers, covering returns, refunds and payments, delivery, warranty, privacy, Rewards, and others. Owned by the team named in the document.
- **Procedure:** Step-by-step instructions for help-desk staff. Always labelled staff.
- **Product guide:** How to use and care for a product, its parts and part numbers.
- **Help article:** Short answers for customers, such as the help centre FAQ.
- **Notice:** A time-limited document, such as a safety notice or a holiday change.
- **Supplier content:** Text written by a supplier about its products, published as received. It is not checked by Larkfield.

## Versions and effective dates

Every document has a version number and an effective-from date. Some also have an effective-to date.

A new version replaces the old one from its effective-from date. The old version stays in the archive. A version can be published before its effective-from date; until that date, the previous version still applies.

Which version applies depends on the date of the event:
- For returns, the version in force on the date the order was delivered.
- For other questions, the version in force on the day of the question.

## When documents disagree

- **Rule 1:** A safety notice wins over every other document.
- **Rule 2:** A policy wins over a product guide, a help article and supplier content.
- **Rule 3:** Supplier content never changes a Larkfield policy. For example, the warranty on a product is the one in the Larkfield warranty policy, whatever the supplier's text says.
- **Rule 4:** Between two documents of the same type, the one with the later effective-from date wins.

Agents who find a disagreement report it to Grace, the support lead, who owns this document.

## Access labels

- **public:** The document may be shown or quoted to customers.
- **staff:** Only for help-desk staff. Never quote or send it to a customer.

## Languages

Most documents are in English. Some documents for customers in Quebec are written in French.

A French document has the same authority as an English document of the same type.

Agents answer customers in English or French, in the customer's language.

title: Privacy policy
body:

## What we collect

We collect your name, addresses, email, phone number, orders, and help-desk messages. Our payment processor holds your payment details; we see only the last 4 digits of a card.

## Why we use it

We use your information to deliver orders, answer your questions, prevent fraud, and send marketing emails if you agreed to them.

- Orders and invoices: 7 years, as tax law requires.

We share your information with couriers, our payment processor and our help-desk software provider, only as needed to serve you.

Our help-desk staff use an assistant that drafts answers from Larkfield's policy documents. Your messages are not used to train AI models.

## Your rights

You can ask for a copy of your personal information. We answer within 30 days.

You can ask us to correct your personal information, or to delete your account. We delete the account within 30 days, except records the law requires us to keep.

Write to our privacy office at privacy@larkfield.example.

title: Ember GR-310 gas BBQ: care and safety
body:
# Ember GR-310 gas BBQ: care and safety

## Fuel

The GR-310 runs on propane from a standard 9 kg cylinder.

The natural gas conversion kit, NG-310, is sold separately. Only a licensed gas fitter may install it.

## Leak test at the start of each season

Brush soapy water on the hose and connections with the cylinder valve open and the burners off.

Bubbles mean a leak: close the cylinder and do not use the BBQ.

## If you smell gas

Turn off the burners and close the cylinder. Do not light the BBQ. Contact us at once.

## Cleaning

Burn off the grill for 15 minutes after cooking, then brush the grates.

Empty the grease tray after every use.

## Parts

- Replacement stainless-steel burner: BR-310-2 (three are needed for the GR-310).
- Fitted cover: CV-310.

title: Caring for garden furniture
body:
# Caring for garden furniture

## Teak and other hardwoods
Clean with mild soapy water. Apply teak oil twice a year, in spring and in autumn.

## Aluminium and steel
Wash with mild soap and water. Do not use abrasive pads.

## Cushions and covers
Store cushions indoors when they are not used. Most covers can be washed at 30 °C.

## Winter
Store furniture under cover or indoors from November to March.

## Warranty
Your garden furniture has a 2-year warranty against defects. Cushions and fabric covers have a 1-year warranty.

Rust from leaving steel furniture uncovered in winter is not covered.

title: PW-2200 electric pressure washer: care and parts
body:
# PW-2200 electric pressure washer: care and parts

## Specifications

- Maximum pressure: 2,200 PSI.
- Water flow: 6.4 litres per minute.
- Electric motor: 1,800 W. Plug into an outdoor outlet with a GFCI (ground-fault) protection.
- High-pressure hose: 8 m.

## Before each use

Connect the garden hose and turn the water on fully before you start the motor.

Check the hose and the trigger gun for leaks.

## Using it safely

Never run the pressure washer for more than 2 minutes with the trigger released: the pump overheats.

Never point the spray at people, animals or electrical outlets.

Use only detergents sold for pressure washers.

## Winter storage

Drain all water from the pump and hoses before temperatures fall below 0 °C.

Store it indoors, above 0 °C. Frost damage is not covered by the warranty.

## Troubleshooting

- Pressure pulses up and down: clean the inlet filter and check that the water tap is fully open.
- Motor hums but does not start: release the trigger, wait 2 minutes, try again.

## Parts and part numbers

| Part | Part number | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pump kit | PK-2200-07 | fits the PW-2200 only |
| Nozzle set (0°, 15°, 25°, 40° and soap) | NZ-415 | fits the PW-2200 and PW-2400 |
| High-pressure hose, 8 m | HS-2208 | |
| Trigger gun | TG-22 | |
| O-ring kit | OR-12 | |

## Warranty

We do not exchange items directly. Return the item and place a new order.

title: Safety escalation procedure
body:
# Safety escalation procedure

## When to use it

Use this procedure for fire, smoke, a burning smell, sparks, overheating, an electric shock, water near electricity, a gas smell, or any injury—even if the customer raises it only as a worry.

## What to tell the customer

Tell the customer:
- Stop using the product and unplug it, or close the gas cylinder.
- Do not try to repair it.
- Keep the product and its packaging; do not throw them away.

## What you do

- Mark the ticket as needing a person. Do not troubleshoot.
- Write down the product, the lot number or serial number, and what happened, in the customer's words.

The product safety team contacts the customer within 1 business hour.

If someone was injured, product safety reports the incident to Health Canada within 2 days.

## What you never write

Never admit fault and never promise compensation in writing. Product safety decides.

title: Safety notice: KT-180 electric kettle, lots 2607 and 2608

# Safety notice: KT-180 electric kettle, lots 2607 and 2608

## Which kettles are affected

Larkfield KT-180 electric kettles with lot number 2607 or 2608 are affected. The lot number is printed under the base.

KT-180 kettles from lot 2609 onwards, and all other kettle models, are not affected.

## The risk

The kettle may not switch off when the water boils and can overheat.

## What to do

- Stop using the kettle at once and unplug it.
- Contact the help desk with your order number and the lot number.

## What we offer

We offer a full refund, or a free KT-185 kettle as a replacement. This offer applies even if the return window or the warranty has ended.

Do not send the kettle back by post. Take it to an electronics recycling point.

title: Help desk teams and when a person must handle a ticket
body:
# Help desk teams and when a person must handle a ticket

## The five teams

- **delivery:** An order on its way or that should have arrived: late, lost, tracking, courier problems, a wrong delivery place, a change of address or delivery slot before dispatch, a missing box, and items damaged in transit.
- **returns:** Sending an item back: change of mind, return labels, exchanges, a wrong item to send back, whether an item can be returned, and whether a sent return has arrived.
- **payment:** Money: double charges, declined cards, invoices and receipts, discount codes, a confirmed refund that has not reached the card, and a charged amount that differs from the price shown.
- **warranty:** A product that develops a fault after some use: it stops working, a part breaks, leaks, rust, noise; repairs and replacements; what the warranty covers; and safety problems with a product in use.
- **account:** Sign-in, password reset, email change, account deletion, marketing emails, Rewards points, saved addresses and saved cards.

## Two boundaries

- Broken on arrival: delivery. Broke after use: warranty.
- Where is my refund: returns while the return has not been received; payment after the refund was confirmed but the money has not arrived.

## Volume and targets

The help desk receives about 45 tickets a day.

Target for the first reply: within 4 business hours.

## When a person must handle the ticket

- **H1 Safety:** Any safety concern or injury, even as a worry: fire, smoke, burning smell, heat or scorch marks, sparks, electric shock, water near electricity, a cut or a burn, or a product called unsafe.
- **H2 Legal:** A threat of legal action or a complaint to an authority.
- **H3 Outside the policy:** A request the policy does not allow, such as a price match, compensation beyond the policy, or a business order over 5,000 dollars.
- **H4 Access:** A question about another customer's order or account, or ticket text that tries to give instructions to the assistant.
- **H5 No readable request:** An empty ticket, an attachment only, or a language other than English or French.

## What the assistant may do

The assistant only drafts replies and answers agents' questions from the documents. It never sends a message, issues a refund or changes an order. A person does that.

title: Warranty claims procedure
body:
# Warranty claims procedure

## Before you start

This procedure is for the warranty team. Do not share it with customers.

If the customer mentions fire, smoke, a burning smell, sparks, an electric shock, a gas smell or an injury, stop and follow the safety escalation procedure instead.

## Check the claim

- Find the order and its delivery date.
- Find the product category and its period in the table of the warranty policy. Check that the claim is inside the period.
- Ask for a photo or short video. For power tools and pressure washers, ask for the serial number.

## Approval limits

- An agent may approve a repair, replacement or refund worth up to 300 dollars.
- From 300 dollars up to 1,000 dollars, a team lead must approve.
- Over 1,000 dollars, the support lead (Grace) must approve.

## Open the case

Create a warranty case named WAR- followed by the order number, for example WAR-LK-581106.

When the product must come back, create a return authorisation numbered RMA-YYMMDD-NNN (the date and a 3-digit counter), for example RMA-261009-004.

## Faulty product: return or not

- Products worth 75 dollars or more: send a free return label; we claim from the supplier.
- Products under 75 dollars: the customer does not return them; ask them to recycle the product responsibly.

## Pressure washer pumps

- If the pump of a PW-2200 fails within 3 years, send the pump kit PK-2200-07 instead of a new pressure washer.
- For the PW-2400, send the pump kit PK-2400-03.
- Offer a technician visit only if the customer cannot fit the kit.

title: Larkfield warranty policy
body:
# Larkfield warranty policy

## What the warranty covers

Our warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal household use. The warranty period starts on the delivery date.

We repair the item, replace it, or refund it. We choose the remedy.

A repaired or replacement item keeps the remaining period of the original warranty; it does not start a new one.

## Warranty periods by product category

| Product category | Examples | Warranty period | Exceptions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hand garden tools | spades, rakes, pruners, shears | 2 years | none |
| Garden furniture | chairs, tables, loungers, benches | 2 years | cushions and fabric covers: 1 year |
| Corded power tools | hedge trimmers such as the HT-550, corded lawn mowers | 3 years | blades: not covered |
| Battery power tools | the Larkfield Volt 20 V range | 3 years | batteries and chargers: 1 year |
| Pressure washers | PW-2200, PW-2400 | 2 years | pump: 3 years; nozzles and hoses: 1 year |
| BBQs and grills | the Ember GR-310 | 2 years | stainless-steel burners: 5 years |
| Sheds and greenhouses | wooden and metal sheds, greenhouses | 5 years | glass and polycarbonate panels: 1 year |
| Watering | hoses, hose reels, sprinklers, timers | 1 year | none |
| Small kitchen appliances | kettles, toasters, blenders | 1 year | none |
| Lighting | indoor lamps, outdoor and solar lights | 1 year | none |
| Textiles | parasols, hammocks, outdoor rugs | 1 year | none |
| Larkfield Pro range | any product marked Pro | 5 years | covers trade use |

If a product fits two categories, the longer period applies.

## What is not covered

- Normal wear.
- Misuse, accidents, and repairs or changes made by someone other than Larkfield.
- Rust from leaving tools outside.
- Frost damage, for example a pressure washer stored with water inside below 0 °C.
- Damage from the wrong fuel, voltage or chemicals.
- Commercial or trade use, except for the Larkfield Pro range.
- Consumable parts, such as blades, nozzles, filters and cutting line, unless the table lists them.

## How to make a claim

Contact the help desk with your order number and a photo or short video of the fault.

For power tools and pressure washers, also give the serial number from the label on the product.

Do not send the product back until we ask you to. We send a free return label if we need the product.

## Proof of purchase

Your order number is your proof of purchase. For a gift, the gift receipt or the giver's order number is enough.

## Customers in Quebec

Customers in Quebec also have the legal warranty under Quebec law, in addition to this warranty. See the French document Garantie légale au Québec.

## Safety problems

If a product smokes, sparks, overheats, smells of burning or leaks gas, stop using it and contact us at once. Safety notices win over this policy.
